name: Sankhya Philosophy
description: Existence as the interaction between eternal consciousness (Purusha) and ever-changing material nature (Prakriti)—a lens for witnessing the unfolding of reality as illusion (maya).

name: The Yugas
description: Cyclical epochs describing humanity's spiritual and moral evolution across four repeating ages—Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali—offering a long-wave lens on consciousness rise, decay, and renewal.

name: Empire Cycles
description: Empires rise on education and innovation, peak on trade and currency dominance, and decline through debt, division, and rigidity.

name: The Fourth Turning
description: Society undergoes a profound Crisis roughly every 80–100 years to dismantle and rebuild core institutions. We are currently in such a Crisis phase, expected to culminate in the early-to-mid 2030s.

name: The Network State
description: Digitally-native, opt-in communities organized around shared values and coordinated online, gaining real-world influence through collective action and eventual diplomatic recognition.

name: Integral Theory
description: A unifying framework mapping human experience across interior/exterior and individual/collective perspectives, integrating developmental stages, states of consciousness, and multiple knowledge systems.
